description: Only the terminal that elision restores is checked: a test on a later symbol of an elidable optional, a test on the first symbol of an optional that is not elidable, and a test on a terminator that no %elidable names are no errors (engine §3.8).
grammar:
%elidable KU
%rule text A [KU B≠"b"] [LE⊇~x KU] [VAU∩~x=∅] C
